errors.evidence: This statement claims that all TDNN-HMM values are close to or slightly above 30%. However, the values for Test3 (approx. 26.5%) and Test4 (approx. 27.8%) are significantly lower than 30%.

errors.evidence: The EDR values for DNN-HMM are not within the range of 22% to 25%. The value for Test3 is approximately 20%, which is outside this range.

This range is incorrect for both the End-to-End and LSTM-HMM models. The LSTM-HMM value for Test1 is approximately 10.5%, which is below 12%. The End-to-End value for Test3 is approximately 18.5%, which is above 18%.
